messages:
noah_sales: Quick help please 7 AcmeNova POC using our TS SDK behind corp proxy. They see intermittent 429s and sometimes streaming stops after ~20-40s. Can we triage?
tess_se: Common symptom of proxy killing idle streams or HTTP/2 multiplex issues. Do they have a client snippet or logs?
omar_devex: They shared this small error log:
```
stream error: unexpected end of input
http status: 429
client: node-fetch v3
proxy: proxy.corp:8080
```
iris_support: On our side traces show upstream accepted then later a FIN from their proxy around 60s. Also some requests show EAI_AGAIN DNS errors.
noah_sales: Customer wants to know if Dedicated or a small bastion is needed now or later, and if it'll change pricing for the POC.
tess_se: Short plan: 1) try client config fixes first (keepalive, force http1.1), 2) add simple retry/backoff cap, 3) if still flaky, use outbound bastion. That will add a small infra cost but usually <$250/mo for POC.
omar_devex: Quick TS suggestions to send them:
- Force HTTP/1.1 (disable h2 multiplex) as test
- Use an http.Agent with keepAlive=true and keepAliveMsecs=30000
- Set streaming idle timeout on client to surface stalls early (e.g., 60-90s)
- Retry 429 with exponential backoff + jitter, max 3 attempts
- Ensure HTTP_PROXY/NO_PROXY env vars include the Redwood host for direct egress tests

Also Python snippet for reference:
```
# requests with pool and retries
s = requests.Session()
adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=10, pool_maxsize=50, max_retries=Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.4))
s.mount('https://', adapter)
resp = s.post(url, timeout=(5,60))
```
iris_support: If they can run `curl --http1.1 -N -v` behind the proxy and share tcpdump + timing, we can confirm h2 vs proxy behavior.
billing-bot: estimator: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/bastion/estimate  small egress bastion est: $90$230/mo depending on region and bandwidth.
noah_sales: Great. Please paste this checklist into the POC doc and ping the account team. Also include the estimator link and note this won't change SOC artifacts unless they request Private deployment.
tess_se: Confirmed: NAT/bastion itself doesn't require extra SOC docs. Private (VPC/on-prem) follows enterprise compliance flow.
omar_devex: TL;DR for customer: most likely proxy/TCP/DNS -> try HTTP/1.1 + keepalives + limited retries. If unstable, use bastion; we'll join debug call.
noah_sales: Scheduled a 30m debug call for tomorrow 9am PT. Please join if available. Thanks!
